design.universe: PIT all-A plus delisted local bars
design.value: parent net profit / PIT float market cap
design.market_gate: PIT cap-weighted all-A index > 200-day MA at signal
design.risk_overlay: none beyond the MA200 gate; 100% invested when gate is on
design.execution: monthly, next open, 5% band, lot/commission/stamp tax

limitations: No full CSI 300/all-A index history is present; the MA200 gate uses a locally built PIT float-cap-weighted all-A proxy.
The full-A annual panel has no debt-ratio field; quality is ROE plus net margin, not a leverage-adjusted quality score.
Annual reports are used; TTM fundamental variants are not part of this pre-registered test.
Historical ST status is unavailable; price/ADV/history filters are the proxy.
Only delisted names with local bars can trade; others are absent.
2025-2026 was observed in earlier research, so it is a time holdout, not pristine out-of-sample.
